title: Preserve tool ownership while exposing scoped ACP tools to inference
goal: Vision: V-6. Supply session-owned tool schemas to GEMI and fulfill their calls through the existing tool bus without changing genuinely caller-owned tools or leaking fleet diagnostics onto ACP stdout. Parent T-CODEX100KACPBRIDGE-1 owns actual root wiring and integration.
